latestVersion.changelog:
- 支持 Dribbble、Pinterest、Behance 三个平台
- 公开检索优先，不依赖登录态
- 采用“搜索页优先、详情页轻量补充”的低请求策略
- 适合灵感检索、趋势观察、公开素材聚合

- Initial public release of design-platform-search.
- Enables public design search on Dribbble, Pinterest, and Behance without requiring login.
- Normalizes and extracts key fields: title, cover image, author, source URL, and publish time (when available).
- Prioritizes browser automation and search-page data over deep scraping; detail page access kept minimal and optional.
- Provides clear workflow, extraction priorities, and network guidance for stable, login-free searches.
- Outputs consistent, normalized records with nullable fields for missing or unstable data.
